title: PlanMyAgents capability descriptions
description: Per-capability human-readable descriptions shown to the goal decomposer LLM so it reuses router-supported slugs instead of coining synonyms. The decomposer receives the `capabilities` map verbatim as part of its catalog_hint.

capabilities.description: Map of capability slug -> description block. The slug MUST be a router-supported capability id from agents.json. The decomposer hot path looks up slugs in this map by exact string match.

description.description: One or two sentences describing what the capability does and (crucially) what it is NOT. The decomposer reads this to decide reuse vs. coining.

examples.description: Two to five concrete example sub-tasks that should map to this capability. Examples teach the LLM by analogy and are higher-signal than the description alone.
